calls.statement:
SELECT 
    do.region,
    d.calendar_month,
    SUM(f.gross_amount) as gross_sales_vat
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON f.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_store_old do ON ds.store_id = do.store_id
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024 
  AND d.calendar_month IN (8, 9)
  AND ds.store_id < 900  -- exclude online/pseudo-locations
GROUP BY do.region, d.calendar_month
ORDER BY do.region, d.calendar_month

calls.statement:
SELECT 
    dso.region,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.calendar_month = 8 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as August_2024,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.calendar_month = 9 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as September_2024
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON f.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_store_old dso ON ds.store_id = dso.store_id
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024 
  AND d.calendar_month IN (8, 9)
  AND ds.store_id < 900
GROUP BY dso.region
ORDER BY dso.region

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_sales_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024 
  AND d.calendar_month IN (8, 9)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ds.store_id) as stores_in_sales,
       COUNT(DISTINCT dso.store_id) as stores_in_old_mapping
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON f.store_key = ds.store_key
LEFT JOIN dim_store_old dso ON ds.store_id = dso.store_id
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024 
  AND d.calendar_month IN (8, 9)
  AND ds.store_id < 900

SELECT DISTINCT ds.store_id, ds.store_name, ds.region
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON f.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024 
  AND d.calendar_month IN (8, 9)
  AND ds.store_id >= 900
ORDER BY ds.store_id
